description: Where to give to a charity on livedot for Good: the charity's own donation page and, for an event, each fundraiser's own Support page. Links only: livedot never handles money. Use it for "how do I donate to Brightpath", "sponsor Kea in the Coast Ride". Never call a link a partner's.

charity.description: The charity as the user said it: its name ("Brightpath"), its livedot address (livedot.me/brightpath) or slug.

event.description: The event's name, id or link, for its fundraisers' links.

person.description: One fundraiser's name, as the user said it.

name: support_links

outputSchema.description: Where to give: the charity's donation page and each fundraiser's own Support page. Links only.

charity.description: The charity: slug, name, url (its livedot page), demo (true for the demo charity).

demo.description: The demo charity: its links open livedot.me/good, never a donation page.

donate.description: The charity's own donation page (url, name, host), or null.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

event.description: The event the fundraisers are from: id, name, url.

fundraisers.description: Each fundraiser's Support link as they set it (name, url, page, host), for the event asked about.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

sponsor_line.description: The line a free answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free (never on an answer with a Donate or Support link).

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Where to give
